protestant-66-paratext-english.description: Protestant 66-book canon with SIL/Paratext English (ScrVers.English) versification restricted to CAIF positive-integer coordinates.
protestant-66-paratext-english.coordinate_subset: Positive-integer chapter and verse coordinates supported by BiblePassageReference; null verse endpoints select complete chapters.
protestant-66-paratext-english.verse_counts_semantics: Each stored value is a maximum verse address; every positive integer from 1 through that maximum is valid. Chapter number equals array index plus one.
protestant-66-paratext-english.language_note: English in the profile ID names the versification convention, not an input-language restriction.
limitations: Valid reference addresses do not specify which verses a translation prints in its main text.
Additional upstream books are excluded from P0.
Whole-chapter references remain whole-chapter references and MUST NOT be expanded into verse ranges.
